svg.title: MVC — two competing views on one live game

g.text: MVC — two competing views on one live game
Every action, from a click, a typed command or a virtual player,
goes through the same validation. It is applied to a copy and
committed only if the engine accepts it. Both views are then notified,
so a move typed in the terminal appears in the window and vice versa.
The model has no dependency on JavaFX,
the command line or the preferences.
